song_craft: Descent promised (4v): free cause → unborrowing bloom → one-yet-many → knot-knower. Wonder at unborrowing opening.

lines: Knowing stands free — the world's threefold turning
comes from it alone: arising, abiding, returning.

lines: By her own will she blooms it, on her own ground —
no borrowed hands, no borrowed earth, in the opening.

lines: One, yet many — where fit seer meets fit seen,

wearing a world shrunk to fit.
